info.title: OneXtel RCS API
info.description:
Create and fetch RCS templates, send RCS template and standalone messages, upload media and manage opt-in / opt-out lists.

Generated from the OneXtel API reference by scripts/build-openapi.py.

data.description: JSON string (see below) describing the template — `name`, `type`, content fields, and optional `suggestions`.

sender_profile_name.description: The RCS sender profile the template belongs to.

update_by.description: Identifier of the user/system submitting the template.

multimedia_files.description: Media file to attach, for template types that include media (image, video, or document).

suggestions.description: Array of suggested actions. Can be empty (`[]`).

displayText.description: The button text shown to the user.

postback.description: Data sent back to the bot when the user interacts with the suggestion. Used for internal logic/tracking.

url.description: URL to open when the user taps the suggestion. Required when `suggestionType` is `url_action`.

phoneNumber.description: Phone number to call when the user taps the suggestion. Required when `suggestionType` is `dialer_action`.

label.description: Label for the map location (e.g. "Our Store"). Required when `suggestionType` is `view_location_latlong`.

latitude.description: Latitude coordinate for the map view. Required when `suggestionType` is `view_location_latlong`.

longitude.description: Longitude coordinate for the map view. Required when `suggestionType` is `view_location_latlong`.

query.description: The query string to search (e.g. "nearest ATM"). Required when `suggestionType` is `view_location_query`.

title.description: Title of the calendar event. Required when `suggestionType` is `calendar_event`.

description.description: Description or notes for the calendar event. Required when `suggestionType` is `calendar_event`.

startTime.description: Event start time, ISO or `yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss` format. Required when `suggestionType` is `calendar_event`.

endTime.description: Event end time, ISO or `yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss` format. Required when `suggestionType` is `calendar_event`.

timeZone.description: Time zone of the event (e.g. "Asia/Kolkata"). Required when `suggestionType` is `calendar_event`.

textMessageContent.description: Message body shown with the media. Supports placeholders like `[custom_param]`.

documentUrl.description: URL of the media file to attach. Supported formats usually include images (`.jpg`, `.png`), videos (`.mp4`), and documents (`.pdf`, `.docx`). The file should be publicly accessible or hosted via an approved CDN.

messageOrder.description: Determines display order of media and text. Accepted values: `media_at_top` (media displayed above text) or `text_message_at_top` (text displayed above media).

orientation.description: Defines the layout of card components. Supported values: `VERTICAL` or `HORIZONTAL`.

height.description: Carousel card height. One of `SHORT_HEIGHT`, `MEDIUM_HEIGHT`, or `TALL_HEIGHT`.

alignment.description: Card alignment. Applies to `HORIZONTAL` orientation only. Supported values: `LEFT` or `RIGHT`.

standAlone.description: An object that defines media, text, and actions for this single rich card. See fields below.

mediaUrl.description: Image/video URL used in the card.

cardTitle.description: Title of the carousel card, e.g. `"New York Store"`.

cardDescription.description: Description shown below the title, e.g. `"Visit us in NYC and grab exciting deals!"`.

width.description: Carousel card width. One of `MEDIUM_WIDTH`, `SMALL_WIDTH`, or `SHORT_WIDTH`.

carouselList.description: Array of carousel card objects — see fields below.

senderProfile.description: RCS sender profile identifier from which templates are fetched.

pageNo.description: Page number for pagination. Must be a non-negative integer.

limit.description: Number of records to return per page.

status.description: Filters templates based on approval status: `Approved`, `Pending`, or `Rejected`.

createdDate.description: Filters templates by creation timestamp, local datetime format `YYYY-MM-DDTHH:mm:ss`.

templateName.description: RCS template name to filter by.

post.summary: Send an RCS Template Message / Send Non-Template Messages

rcs.description: Wrapper array of one or more message objects. Supports up to 500 objects per request (many-to-many use case).

prefix.description: Country code prefix applied to recipient numbers (e.g. `+91`). Optional per the Postman collection; documented as mandatory in the PDF's common parameters table — see Gaps.

flag.description: `1` to enable URL shortening, `0` to disable.

longUrl.description: The original full URL to shorten.

senderId.description: Sender ID or bot ID associated with the message (matches your RCS sender).

domain.description: Custom domain to use for the shortened link.

track_user.description: Whether to enable user-level click tracking. Default: disabled.

urlShortener.description: Optional object used only if links in the message body need shortening/tracking. See fields below.

recipient.description: Recipient phone number, without prefix. Can also be an array to support a one-to-many use case, containing up to 500 numbers in a single request.

sender.description: Sender bot ID or sender phone number.

contentMessage.description: Holds the message payload. For a template message, this contains a `templateMessage` object (documented below). `contentMessage` can alternatively hold `text` or `richCard` for non-template messages.

ttl.description: Time-to-live for the message (e.g. `"1200s"`). Only applicable in some transactional messages.

expireTime.description: Optional absolute expiry timestamp for the message, ISO 8601 (e.g. `"2024-10-02T15:01:23Z"`).

custref6.description: Optional custom reference field. Appears in plain-text message examples; not shown in every template example — see Gaps.

templateCode.description: Template identifier, matching the `name` used when the template was created (e.g. `"my_template_otp"`).

customParams.description: A JSON string of key-value pairs replacing the template's placeholder variables (e.g. `[custom_param]`). Not required for templates with no placeholders.

flag.description: `1` = enable URL shortening, `0` = disable. Mandatory if URL shortening is required in the message body.

urlDetails.description: Array of URL-shortening definitions. Each entry defines `longUrl`, `senderId`/`domain`, and `track_user`.

longUrl.description: The original (full) URL you want to shortened. Mandatory if `urlShortener.flag` is set to `1`.

senderId.description: The sender ID or bot ID associated with the message (matches your RCS sender). Named `senderId` in the Send Message examples and `domain` in the parameter reference table for the same field — see Gaps.

domain.description: The domain used for the shortened URL.

track_user.description: Whether to enable user-level click tracking (e.g. `true` or `1`). Default: disabled.

expiry.description: Optional expiry for the shortened URL.

senderProfileName.description: Registered RCS sender profile name (your RCS bot/sender ID).

message_type.description: Type of RCS message the media will be used with, e.g. `transactional` or `promotional`.

file.description: The media file to upload (multipart), e.g. an image, GIF, or video. Required unless you supply `url` instead.

url.description: A public URL to fetch the media from, instead of uploading a file.

numbers.description: Array of recipient phone numbers to opt out.

sender.description: RCS sender/bot ID the opt-out applies to.

message_types.description: Message types to opt the numbers out of, e.g. `["promotional", "transactional"]`.

numbers.description: Array of recipient phone numbers to opt in.

sender.description: RCS sender/bot ID the opt-in applies to.

message_types.description: Message types to opt the numbers into, e.g. `["promotional", "transactional"]`.

parameters.name: number
parameters.description: Recipient phone number to remove from the opt-in list.

parameters.name: sender
parameters.description: RCS sender/bot ID the opt-in applies to.

parameters.name: message_type
parameters.description: Message type to remove the opt-in for. One of `promotional`, `transactional`.
